title: Signature 12 · Muscle Hourglass · Palekh · Snowy Birch
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, long voluminous curls with a delicate gold tiara.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Russian Palekh lacquer painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Deep glossy black lacquer densely covered with fine gold-leaf vine scrolls, firebird feather ornaments, and jewel-tone red, blue, and green flowers. The gold scrolls wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. No borders, no bands, not a corset. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing in a glamour pose, wide stance with a strong hip shift, arms hanging relaxed slightly away from the body, no flexing.

Footwear: Extremely high red lacquer platform stiletto mules with gold straps. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A snowy birch forest on a bright winter morning, white snow and pale trunks, the background much lighter than her body, soft low sunlight carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making the gold leaf glow, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
